summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload disguised as a Cypress helper
details: The package advertises itself as a Cypress helper library, but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, chmods the binary executable, and immediately invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscated blob using rotated string/number arrays (`n7gIxM`, `WV8StW` shift-decoder, `hc1jfK9` alphabet decoder) and hex-named identifiers, entirely unrelated to the tiny TypeScript exports in `src/`. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated with `_0xNNNN` identifiers and per-function inline lookup tables mapping short keys to literal arguments (`--version`, `/etc/os-release`, `Alpine`, etc.), which is not the output of any legitimate bundler for a lifecycle-hook loader. The alternate-runtime-dropper design executes the payload under Bun so Node-based sandboxing and telemetry do not observe it. Installing the package auto-runs the payload under the freshly downloaded runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
